{{Quote|That is Varykino, a prize of the Lake Country. Once owned by the poet Omar Berenko, and presently occupied by the Naberrie family.|[[Cosinga Palpatine]], to [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]|<ref name="Plagueis" />}}
'''Varykino Villa''', also known as the '''Lake Retreat''', was the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family's]] estate in a [[Unidentified Naboo lake|lake]] at the [[Lake Country/Legends|Lake Country]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] also the name of the island on which the house was situated. [[Convergence/Legends|Convergence]], the ancestral home of [[House Palpatine/Legends|House Palpatine]], was situated at some distance from Varykino.<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

==History==
===Before the Clone Wars===
{{Quote|This is Lake Retreat of the Naberrie family, one of the most honored families in Naboo history. Queen Padmé Amidala was a Naberrie, along with several former Senators and many high officials.|Lareen Dantara to an unnamed spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
[[File:Anakin_at_Varykino.png|thumb|left|240px|Anakin meditates at Varykino.]]
Centuries prior to the Naberrie family's tenancy, the retreat was occupied by the celebrated and controversial [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Poet/Legends|poet]], [[Omar Berenko/Legends|Omar Berenko]]. In the villa rotunda known as the [[Room of Morning Mists/Legends|Room of Morning Mists]], he wrote one of his most famous poems, [[Defense of Naboo/Legends|''Defense of Naboo'']]. Berenko was kidnapped by unknown assailants from one of the [[Varykino/Legends|island]] lodge's shaded balconies and was never seen again.<ref name="IWSWAOTC">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref>

When [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was in Level Three schooling, she visited the villa during school retreat along with friends and family. They used to swim out to a [[Amidala's Beach|neighboring island]], where an elderly jeweler crafted beautiful vases and [[Necklace/Legends|necklaces]] out of [[Glass/Legends|glass]].<ref name="AOTC novel">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref> [[Paddy Accu/Legends|Paddy Accu]], the retreat's caretaker, was delighted to take the young Padmé on thrilling rides in his [[Gondola Speeder/Legends|Gondola Speeder]]. He had served the [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] and the [[Naberrie family/Legends|Naberrie family]] for [[Standard year/Legends|years]], before Amidala became [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="FF87">{{FactFile|87|NAB 7-8|Naboo Gondola Speeder}}</ref>

Shortly after two failed [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempts]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Amidala used the retreat as a sanctuary. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], [[Teckla Minnau/Legends|Teckla Minnau]] and her half-sister [[Nandi]] were the servants who tended the guests, with Paddy still the caretaker.<ref name="AOTC" /> Minnau would subsequently join Amidala's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senatorial]] staff on Coruscant.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> During this retreat, Amidala was accompanied by her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protector, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. The two of them fell in love during their stay. After the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], Padmé Amidala and Anakin Skywalker returned to Varykino, where they were [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|secretly married]] by [[Maxiron Agolerga/Legends|Maxiron Agolerga]], a Naboo holy man.<ref name="AOTC" />

===During the Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Um, Master... How did you ''find'' me?''"<br />"''Anakin, every Padawan on Coruscant knows where to find you. But I don't care what you do on leave.|Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="obsession2">[[Obsession 2|''Obsession'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:LakeRetreatInterior.jpg|thumb|right|175px|The romantic interior of the Lake Retreat]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a Naboo [[Wine/Legends|wine]] named [[Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac/Legends|Domaine de la Maison sur le Lac]] was often consumed at the Galactic Senate on Coruscant. On the bottle label, we could read the brand name and the phrase "Produce of Naboo," as well as see a picture of Varykino. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Amidala, along with [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], and the latter's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]], drank this beverage in celebration of her latest speech in favor of the [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|reduction of military spending]]. Unbeknownst to Amidala, the wine had been mixed with a lethal [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that exclusively affected [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Blood/Legends|blood]] by Purs, who wanted to take revenge on Farr for his temporary alliance with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]].<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref> Furthermore, Amidala had a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] of Varykino hanging on the wall of her [[Padmé's office/Legends|Senatorial office]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] Amidala planned to raise her and Anakin's child at the Lake Retreat. However, she [[Death/Legends|died]] on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], giving birth to their [[Twin/Legends|twins]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Skywalker]].<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

===After the Clone Wars===
After Amidala's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]], her maternal grandmother, [[Ryoo Thule]], spent the next six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] mourning in isolation at the retreat's [[Translucence Cove]]. She found peace there because she knew that Amidala loved that place. When Thule finally decided that it was time to return to her life in [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Malorum]] stopped by to interrogate her because, as per Naboo custom, Thule had been the one to oversee Padmé's funeral. Her defiance to his questions led him to deduce that Amidala's offspring had not died. The Inquisitor then proceeded to kill Thule. A few times later, [[Ferus Olin]] and [[Trever Flume]] arrived in turn at the Lake Retreat. With her dying breath, Thule begged Olin to protect her granddaughter's memory.<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Varykino would have been lent to the Royal House of Naboo and reserved for the private use of friends, family, and loyal subjects. It also became the site of many [[Marriage/Legends|wedding]] ceremonies. At this time, a woman named [[Lareen Dantara]] worked at the Lake Retreat. [[Amidala's Beach|Amidala's beach]], situated near the villa, was well-known as the favorite resting place of Naboo's most famous rulers.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Conception.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Luke and Leia, conceived at Varykino?]]
[[Randy Stradley]] stated that Luke and Leia were conceived in Varykino in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], five months before the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], in the [[Dark Horse Comics]] message boards.<ref name="DH">{{DHBoards|url=viewtopic.php?p=115627#p115627|thread=Huge gaping hole for a story that NEEDS to be told|user=[[Randy Stradley]]|date=2005-12-11|time=07:27|nobackup=1}}</ref> The creators of ''[[Star Wars: Clone Wars]]'', also joked about Luke and Leia being conceived in [[Chapter 22 (Star Wars: Clone Wars)|Chapter 22 of their series]], in a scene that takes place on Naboo and what appears to be Varykino. However, Stradley's statement was made when [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] was assumed to take place over a period of [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] rather than [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Luke and Leia may still have been conceived in Varykino, but this must have occurred nearly nine months before the Battle of Coruscant and the beginning of ''Revenge of the Sith''.

The Varykino scenes were filmed at [[Villa del Balbianello]], on [[Lake Como]], [[Wikipedia:Italy|Italy]].<ref name="Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The interiors, which were sets constructed on a soundstage, were inspired by the basic architecture found in [[Wikipedia:Caserta|Caserta]], where Theed was filmed, but mixed with a softer, personalized style.<ref name="Naboo lake retreat" />

Varykino shares its name with an estate in the novel and film ''Doctor Zhivago'', although official sources have made no comment on this.
